mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increases the relative attractiveness of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention through rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 580,000 units over the past 2 months signals a contraction in residential investment, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve to stimulate the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST falls below 580.0, or the signal generates positive returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which increases the probability of monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model with interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 360 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong underlying demand momentum, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.2% over the past 3 months, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with delayed policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.2 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a tight labor market that pressures the Federal Reserve to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE < 9.0%, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, as measured by the latest quarterly GDPC1 reading, signals a weakening economy, which increases the likelihood of fiscal and monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 is below 1.0% annualized, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of instances.
